The Hisense X-Zone Mini Washer Dryer combines washing and drying functions in one appliance. Its compact design makes it suitable for smaller laundry spaces.

Direct Drive Inverter Motor

Automatic Detergent Dosing

Wash & Dry Function

Drum Clean Cycle

Spin Performance
